stage_entry_measurement.note: Measured before any MD-B19 mutation. These are the numbers normalization must resolve, not the numbers the stage will close on.
stage_entry_measurement.denominator_reason: 222 of the 290 required rows carry transitional MANDATORY_OR_CONDITIONAL. The executable denominator cannot be stated until each is resolved to MANDATORY, CONDITIONAL_APPLICABLE or CONDITIONAL_NOT_APPLICABLE against its own predicate. The register's 224 figure is provisional and is not carried forward as fact.
stage_entry_measurement.reference_population_note: 646 REFERENCE_ONLY rows are the largest such population in the package. A reference row can carry an executable obligation that no gate sees, so stage-entry normalization must examine them rather than accept the classification.
